ic_t_g(1).description: Initial temperature of gas inside the bed, positive value

ic_t_s(1,1).description: Initial temperature of char particles inside the bed, positive value

ic_t_s(2,2).description: Initial temperature of glass beads inside the bed, positive value

ic_y_s(2).description: starting point of glass beads inside the bed, smaller than ending point

ic_y_n(2).description: ending point of glass beads inside the bed, larger than starting point

bc_t_g(2).description: Temperature of gas at the inlet, positive value

bc_v_g(2).description: Velocity of gas at the inlet, negative value

bc_y_g(2,1).description: Mass fraction of species 1 (O2) at the inlet

bc_y_g(2,2).description: Mass fraction of species 2 (N2) at the inlet

bc_y_g(2,5).description: Mass fraction of species 5 (H2O) at the inlet

bc_t_s(3,1).description: temperature of char particles at the inlet, positive value

bc_massflow_s(3,1).description: Mass flow rate of char particles at the inlet, positive value

bc_pic_mi_const_statwt(3,1).description: PIC weight for the char particles. The lower value when d_p0(1) is larger, the higher value when d_p0(1) is smaller. Both of them are very important. Positive integer

bc_p_g(5).description: Pressure of gas at the outlet, positive value
